title: Prawn on the Piano
style: Balkan pop with cheeky Aussie comedy, brisk bouncing groove, and sudden dynamic shifts; verse starts sparse with piano melody and handclap drive, pre-chorus opens up with accordion-style synth stabs and stop-start breaks, chorus hits full with brass punches, group shouts, and a key-change lift. Playful lead vocal with character voices, tight doubles on punchlines, shouted ad-libs in parentheses. Ear candy includes reversed piano swells, whistle fills, and a big last-beat drop before each chorus. Bright, glossy, and slightly chaotic mix., comedy, pop, dynamic
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I rocked up late in thongs
To a wedding in the rain
Nan said, “Mate, you’re cooked”
Then she borrowed my cane
There’s a sausage on the table
There’s a seagull on the roof
And Uncle Kev is dancing
Like he’s got something to prove

[Pre-Chorus]
Hold up, hold up
Don’t start yet
She said, “One more skewer”
I said, “Bet”
The room went quiet
Then the tempo flipped
My cousin did the worm
Off the counter, off the chip

[Chorus]
Oi, oi, pass the prawn
(oi, oi, pass the prawn)
We’re cooked but we’re still on
(passed the prawn)
Oi, oi, pass the prawn
We’re laughing till the sun
And if the plates all vanish
We’ll just nick another one

[Verse 2]
The bloke on the veranda
Had a mullet like a flag
He whispered, “I’m a legend”
Then he tripped on the swag
Auntie said, “You’re dreaming”
With a wink and a grin
Then she slapped two fresh meat pies
And called the whole thing in

[Pre-Chorus]
Hold up, hold up
Shh, listen now
That piano’s getting naughty
And the bass said, “How?”
The whole place froze
Then the floor shook back
Someone yelled, “Too easy!”
As the lights went black

[Chorus]
Oi, oi, pass the prawn
(oi, oi, pass the prawn)
We’re cooked but we’re still on
(passed the prawn)
Oi, oi, pass the prawn
We’re laughing till the sun
And if the plates all vanish
We’ll just nick another one

[Bridge]
[Breakdown]
Then it all went tiny
Just feet and one clean note
Nan in the corner
Spinning in her coat
I said, “How’d you do that?”
She said, “Mind your own”
Then the whole room kicked back in
Like a busted rolling stone

[Final Chorus]
Oi, oi, pass the prawn
(oi, oi, pass the prawn)
We’re cooked but we’re still on
(passed the prawn)
Oi, oi, pass the prawn
We’re laughing till the sun
And if the plates all vanish
We’ll just nick another one

[Outro]
Nah, mate
That one’s mine
(too easy)
